sentences.l1: There is a new kind of plastic bag.

sentences.l2: 它和普通的塑料袋不一样。
sentences.l1: It is different from ordinary plastic bags.

sentences.l2: 普通的塑料袋用石油做。
sentences.l1: Ordinary plastic bags are made from oil.

sentences.l2: 这种新塑料袋用玉米或土豆做。
sentences.l1: This new plastic bag is made from corn or potatoes.

sentences.l2: 可降解的意思是：它能慢慢变小，变成水和二氧化碳。
sentences.l1: Biodegradable means: it can slowly get smaller and turn into water and carbon dioxide.

sentences.l2: 这个过程需要微生物帮忙。
sentences.l1: This process needs microorganisms to help.
Microorganisms are very small, and people cannot see them.

sentences.l2: 它们喜欢温暖潮湿的地方。
在土里或堆肥的地方，微生物会吃这种塑料。
sentences.l1: In soil or in places where compost is made, microorganisms will eat this plastic.

sentences.l2: 科学家在研究这种材料。
他们希望这种塑料能保护环境。
sentences.l1: They hope this plastic can protect the environment.

sentences.l2: 因为普通的塑料要很久才变小，会伤害动物。
sentences.l1: Because ordinary plastic takes a very long time to get smaller, and it harms animals.
This new plastic is good for the environment.
This is progress in materials science.
